Senses.Explanation: Nanquan cuts the cat is the name of the public case in which the east and west halls fight over a cat, Nanquan demands a word, and the assembly does not answer. Later masters question, verse, criticize, and pair the case with Guizong cutting the snake, including explicit precept challenges but no single recorded explanation of Nanquan's intention. The wording functions as a case name, the object of public questions, and the subject of later verses and comments. In Miyun Yuanwu's recorded public interview, a question states that killing living beings is a major precept (殺生是大戒) and asks why Nanquan cut the cat and Guizong cut the snake; Miyun tells the questioner to repent (汝當懺悔去). In a sermon for a newly completed animal-release pond, Guxue Zhe quotes the rule to rescue animals being killed and asks how the cat and snake could have been saved. Guangfu Weishang asks Jueyin, “What is the import of Nanquan cutting the cat?” (南泉斬貓兒，意旨如何); Jueyin answers, “It takes Nanquan” (須是南泉始得). Dahui Zonggao reports and rejects two labels students apply to the paired cutting cases. Wuming Huijing names the cat and snake cases while discussing coarse conduct, and Shanyi Chun places the pair in a teaching-seat statement about cases and precedent. The entry preserves these attested precept challenges, questions, comments, and refusals and does not provide an unrecorded intention for Nanquan.
Senses.Note: Nanquan is a lineage figure and remains on the lineage roster; this dictionary article is for the portable lexical case-name. The cat-graph variants are separate searchable articles, not separate senses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 南泉一日兩堂爭貓，泉提起貓云：「道得即不斬。」眾無對，泉斬貓為兩段。南泉舉問趙州，州脫鞋戴出，泉云：「子在，救得貓兒。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Hongzhi Jue at Tiantong Jingde Monastery in Mingzhou (明州天童景德禪寺宏智覺禪師語錄), old-case section. Hongzhi Zhengjue records the full event: Nanquan demands a word and cuts the cat when the assembly does not answer; Zhaozhou later puts a sandal on his head, and Nanquan says he would have saved the cat. Hongzhi is responsible for this recension; Nanquan and Zhaozhou are the actors inside it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「殺生是大戒，為甚麼南泉斬貓、歸宗斬蛇？」師云：「汝實恁麼問麼？」云：「是。」師云：「汝當懺悔去。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Miyun (密雲禪師語錄), public questions and encounters. An unnamed questioner states that killing living beings is a major precept and asks about Nanquan and Guizong; Miyun Yuanwu asks whether this is truly the question, then tells the questioner to repent.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊道：若見世人殺畜生時，應方便救護，解其苦難。祇如南泉斬貓、歸宗斬蛇，當恁麼時，作何方便可以救得？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Guxue Zhe (古雪哲禪師語錄), sermon for a completed animal-release pond. Guxue Zhe quotes the animal-rescue rule and asks what expedient could have saved the cat and snake. He is not yet in the roster; his title supplies the provisional pinyin form.

Occurrences.Kwic: 初參覺印，問曰：南泉斬貓兒，意旨如何？印曰：須是南泉始得。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Collection of the Five Lamps, volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), section on Guangfu Weishang. Weishang asks Jueyin about the import of the cat-cutting case; Jueyin answers, “It takes Nanquan.” The headword is Weishang's question, so responsibility is assigned to him. He is not yet in the roster; the section heading supplies the provisional pinyin form.

Occurrences.Kwic: 大慧云：『歸宗斬蛇，南泉斬貓。學語之流多，謂之當機妙用，亦謂之大用現前，不存軌則。殊不知總不是這般道理。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Sanyi Yu (三宜盂禪師語錄), citation of Dahui Zonggao. Dahui reports and rejects the two labels students apply to the paired cat- and snake-cutting cases; the headword belongs to Dahui's quoted statement.

Occurrences.Kwic: 故歸宗見僧來即斬蛇，來者謂是麤行沙門；南泉斬貓，兩堂僧擬議不下
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Wuming of Shouchang (壽昌無明和尚語錄), general sermon. Wuming Huijing names Guizong's snake-cutting and Nanquan's cat-cutting while describing the visiting monk's charge of coarse conduct and the two halls' failure to answer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 南泉斬貓，歸宗斬蛇。有例不可興，無例不可缺。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shanyi Chun (善一純禪師語錄), teaching-seat address. Shanyi Chun pairs Nanquan cutting the cat with Guizong cutting the snake and follows them with the statement that a precedent must not be initiated and that absence of precedent must not be lacking. He is not yet in the roster; his title supplies the provisional pinyin form.

Occurrences.Kwic: 歸宗斬蛇。南泉斬猫兒。學語之流。多謂之當機妙用。亦謂之大用現前不存軌則。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師語錄). Dahui Zonggao states the cat-graph variant (南泉斬猫兒) and reports the two labels that he goes on to reject. This family witness anchors the variant but does not count toward exact-headword depth.
